facts.fact: In September 2026 the telecom and postal regulators of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger signed in Ouagadougou a convention creating the Council of Sahel Regulators.
Startup Medias reports the AES digital roadmap, 16 of 18 deliverables finalised, was adopted in Ouagadougou on 5 November 2026 by delegations of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger.
